answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 30313 Country: CG Title: I saw a dream at the time of Tahajjud. Question: Some time ago I saw a dream at the time of Tahajjud/Fajar. In the dream I saw myself with lots of hair on my head, and it was black in colour. My hair at present has thinned, I do not have alot of hair, and since I have White peigmentation skin patches on my skin, so my hair colour is white and black. I would please like the interpretation of this dream, what does it mean?, Jazzak Allah. Answer ID: 30313 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 633/393/D=1432) Excessive hair sometimes indicate to one's wealth, sometime the wealth of one's master while sometime by other means that are related to the situation of dreamer. Hence, you should not be worried to know the meaning of such dreams. You should bring firmness in your Iman, steadfastness in good deeds and concern to avoid sins. These are authentic and clear-cut bases on which Almighty Allah has promised the success of this world and the hereafter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
